description: Every staged component candidate should have keyword, vector, graph, facet, and quality index records before promotion readiness treats it as structurally load-ready.
Generated vector index repair records should reference existing embedding work rows when available, but must not compute embeddings or claim vector search product readiness.
Generated graph index repair records should preserve object-entity references so hierarchy, facet, and dependency traversal remain recoverable after repair loading.
The repair planner should emit JSONL and summary evidence only; applying SQL, updating Postgres, or mutating search indexes requires a separate approved load plan.
Coverage summaries should expose objects with missing index kinds so ID truncation, duplicate collapse, or partial index generation is caught before active component promotion.
